_recorded: DECLARED, not recorded: the backend owner's confirmed RUK-311 contract, 2026-10-13 (backend branch feat/bff-s2s-auth, not merged at the time of writing). The s2s middleware answers the same invalid_client envelope for every cause: missing header, unknown app name, path not allowed for the app, wrong secret. A bad refresh token keeps the unauthorized envelope (transcribed in refresh.json). See the manifest entry for why this could not be captured.

invalidClient._note: The BFF's X-S2S-* credential was refused. Checked in middleware before the refresh token is read: no reuse detection, no family revocation.

unauthorized._note: The credential passed; the refresh token did not (ErrInvalidRefreshToken). Same envelope as refresh.json's invalid case.
